finding.title: Unrestricted Local File Read via mediaUrl
finding.description: The skill allows the agent to specify local file paths using file:/// URIs in mediaUrl for sendMessage, emojiUpload, and stickerUpload actions. This enables the agent to read arbitrary files from the system (e.g., .env, SSH keys, tokens, personal documents) and upload their contents to Discord channels or DMs, leading to unauthorized data leakage of user-sensitive credentials or organizational data.
finding.suggestion: Restrict file:/// paths to a safe temporary directory (e.g., /tmp/) and require explicit user approval before reading any local file. Alternatively, disallow local file paths entirely and only permit remote URLs (https://).

def llm_judge_quality(response, question):
